description: GPU-less WGSL validation for the catalog. tools/naga_wasm wraps the naga WGSL front-end + validator and is built to wasm32 so Node, CI and the browser run the same compiler the host `naga` CLI runs, in-process. Enforced by `npm run verify:naga-wasm` (scripts/verify-naga-wasm.mjs); the artifact's shape is checked by scripts/validate_wasm_artifacts.js. scripts/wgsl_precommit_gate.py keeps the workgroup / bindgroup / extraBuffer checks and no longer needs a naga binary.

notes.pin: Matches the naga-cli minor the CI gate used to `cargo install` (30.0.0). Bumping the minor can change which shaders parse, so a bump must be accompanied by a re-run of `npm run verify:naga-wasm -- --all` and any resulting knownFailures change.
notes.whyCommitted: Same discipline as public/wasm/pixelocity_wasm.wasm: the artifact is committed so `npm start`, `npm run verify:naga-wasm` and CI all work without a Rust toolchain.
notes.noWasmBindgen: The wasm exposes a hand-written C ABI (wgsl_alloc / wgsl_validate / glsl_to_wgsl / wgsl_result_ptr / wgsl_result_len / wgsl_free), so neither wasm-pack nor wasm-bindgen is needed on CI or on agent VMs.
notes.glslIn: glsl-in + wgsl-out back the Shadertoy GLSL import (src/services/shadertoyToPixelocity.ts): naga's GLSL 450 front-end translates, wgsl_validate checks the rewritten compute shader. They do not change which WGSL the validator accepts.

knownFailures.description: Shaders already on main that naga rejects. They predate this gate: scripts/wgsl_precommit_gate.py only ran naga on files changed against origin/main, and --full-tree skips naga entirely for speed, so these never had to pass. The ratchet may only go down — verify:naga-wasm fails both when an unlisted shader breaks and when a listed one starts passing without being removed here.
